code:
SQL Server:
  SELECT * FROM Orders o
  JOIN OrderItems i ON i.OrderId = o.Id

Cosmos DB (3 containers, unchanged shape):
  1) read Orders container
  2) read OrderItems container
  3) stitch results in app code
  -- each round trip costs its own RUs
caption: No server-side JOIN across containers — a cheap relational query can become RU-expensive.
